title: Sleep
description: Every night from every sleep tracker: time asleep, stages, score, the night's heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, breathing, recovery and skin temperature, and how regular the nights are. One colour per source; the tiles read the one you pick.

list.name: tz
list.label: Time zone
list.description: IANA time zone the days and weeks are cut in (TRIBUTARY_TZ).

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.description: The person, in SleepStats (GarminStats holds one person and has no user tag).
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "user"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "user"

list.name: nights
list.label: Night sources
list.description: Every source of nights in SleepStats, for the source lists.
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sleep_session" WITH KEY = "source" WHERE "user" = '$user'

list.name: source
list.label: Sources
list.description: The sources the graphs draw, one colour each.

list.name: sleep_from
list.label: Sleep from
list.description: The source of the time asleep, the stages and the bedtimes.

list.name: score_from
list.label: Sleep score from
list.description: The source of the sleep score. Each device scores on its own scale.

panels.title: Sleep / night
panels.description: Median time asleep per night, from the source picked in Sleep from (naps left out).

targets.query: SELECT median("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Nights tracked
panels.description: Nights the source recorded in the range.

targets.query: SELECT count("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT count("asleep_s") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Deep sleep
panels.description: Share of the time asleep spent in deep sleep, over the range.

targets.query: SELECT sum("deepSleepSeconds") / sum("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("deep_s") / sum("asleep_s") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: REM sleep
panels.description: Share of the time asleep spent in REM sleep, over the range.

targets.query: SELECT sum("remSleepSeconds") / sum("sleepTimeSeconds") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT sum("rem_s") / sum("asleep_s") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Awake / night
panels.description: Median time awake between falling asleep and getting up.

targets.query: SELECT median("awakeSleepSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("awake_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Sleep score
panels.description: Median of the source's own sleep score (0-100). Each app computes it its own way.

targets.query: SELECT median("sleepScore") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${score_from}' AND $timeFilter
SELECT median("score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${score_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Time asleep per night
panels.description: Time asleep each night (points) and its 7-night average (line), one colour per source, naps left out. A night belongs to the day it ends. The dashed line is 7 hours.

targets.query: SELECT sum("sleepTimeSeconds") / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("sleepTimeSeconds"), 7) / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT sum("asleep_s") / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("asleep_s"), 7) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep stages per night · ${sleep_from}
panels.description: Hours of deep, light and REM sleep and time awake, each night, from the source picked in Sleep from (two sources' stages would not add up).

targets.query: SELECT sum("deepSleepSeconds") / 3600 AS "Deep", sum("lightSleepSeconds") / 3600 AS "Light", sum("remSleepSeconds") / 3600 AS "REM", sum("awakeSleepSeconds") / 3600 AS "Awake" FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' = '${sleep_from}' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT sum("deep_s") / 3600 AS "Deep", sum("light_s") / 3600 AS "Light", sum("rem_s") / 3600 AS "REM", sum("awake_s") / 3600 AS "Awake" FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Sleep score
panels.description: Each source's own sleep score (0-100), each night (points) and its 7-night average (line). The scales are the apps' own: compare a source with itself.

targets.query: SELECT mean("sleepScore") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("sleepScore"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("score"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Deep and REM sleep per night
panels.description: 7-night averages of deep sleep (solid) and REM sleep (dashed), one colour per source.

targets.query: SELECT moving_average(sum("deepSleepSeconds"), 7) / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("deep_s"), 7) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("remSleepSeconds"), 7) / 3600 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(sum("rem_s"), 7) / 3600 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Resting heart rate
panels.description: The night's resting heart rate (points) and its 7-night average (line), one colour per source.

targets.query: SELECT mean("restingHeartRate") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("restingHeartRate"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("resting_hr") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("resting_hr"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Heart rate variability
panels.description: Overnight HRV (RMSSD) each night (points) and its 7-night average (line). Devices measure it differently: read each line against itself.

targets.query: SELECT mean("avgOvernightHrv") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("avgOvernightHrv"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("hrv_rmssd_ms") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("hrv_rmssd_ms"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Blood oxygen (SpO₂)
panels.description: Average blood oxygen saturation overnight.

targets.query: SELECT mean("averageSpO2Value") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT moving_average(mean("averageSpO2Value"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("avg_spo2_pct") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("avg_spo2_pct"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Breathing rate
panels.description: Average breaths per minute overnight.

targets.query: SELECT mean("averageRespirationValue") FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("averageRespirationValue"), 7) FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d) fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("respiration_rate") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("respiration_rate"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Recovery score
panels.description: The source's own morning recovery or readiness score (0-100), each night (points) and its 7-night average (line), from the sources that write recovery_score with the night (garmin-grafana keeps its readiness elsewhere).

targets.query: SELECT mean("recovery_score") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("recovery_score"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Skin temperature
panels.description: Skin temperature overnight, each night (points) and its 7-night average (line), from the sources that write skin_temp_c. Read it against its own usual line: a rise can come with an illness or a hard day. garmin-grafana writes a deviation from the watch's baseline instead, not drawn here.

targets.query: SELECT mean("skin_temp_c") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT moving_average(mean("skin_temp_c"), 7) FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND time >= ${__from}ms - 7d AND time <= ${__to}ms GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Usual bedtime
panels.description: The average time the source says you fell asleep (local time), from the source picked in Sleep from. Sources that write bedtime_min only: Garmin's summary has no bedtime.

targets.query: SELECT (mean("bedtime_min") + 1440) % 1440 * 60000 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Usual wake-up
panels.description: The average time the night ended (local time), from the source picked in Sleep from.

targets.query: SELECT (mean("wake_min") + 1440) % 1440 * 60000 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Bedtime spread
panels.description: Standard deviation of the bedtime from night to night: the lower, the more regular.

targets.query: SELECT stddev("bedtime_min") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Wake-up spread
panels.description: Standard deviation of the wake-up time from night to night.

targets.query: SELECT stddev("wake_min") FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" = '${sleep_from}' AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY "source"

panels.title: Bedtime and wake-up
panels.description: When each night began (points) and ended (dashed), in hours from midnight: -1 is 23:00, 7.5 is 07:30. From the sources that write bedtime_min and wake_min (not Garmin's summary).

targets.query: SELECT mean("bedtime_min") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
SELECT mean("wake_min") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')

panels.title: Night-to-night spread of time asleep, per week
panels.description: Standard deviation of the time asleep within each week (Monday to Sunday), one line per source: the lower, the steadier. Every source has it, Garmin's included.

targets.query: SELECT stddev("sleepTimeSeconds") / 60 FROM "SleepSummary" WHERE 'garmin' =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d) fill(none) tz('$tz')

SELECT stddev("asleep_s") / 60 FROM "sleep_session" WHERE "source" =~ /^${source:regex}$/ AND "user" = '$user' AND "kind" != 'nap' AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1w, -3d), "source" fill(none) tz('$tz')
